caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped plaque rendered in shades of brown and tan, with a three-dimensional appearance. At the center of the plaque are two right hands clasping in a handshake, detailed with cuffs at the wrists. Below the hands, the number "1836" is prominently displayed. Surrounding the central image, there is raised lettering forming a circular border, reading "MUTUAL FIRE INSURANCE CO. NIAGARA DIST." The plaque has a scalloped outer edge, and there is a small circular hole on the left side, possibly for mounting. The background is a plain, light beige. On the lower right of the drawing, the name "ROSE CAMPBELL-GERKE" is written in small capital letters.
title: Firemark
